Why Travel To Us

Worth the Short Journey

While there may be dental practices closer to you, dental implants require significant training and experience. Our clinic offers the experience, technology, and results that make the journey worthwhile.

  • Highly experienced implant dentists with 50+ years combined experience
  • Premium dental implants with zirconia crowns as standard
  • Advanced 3D scanning and planning technology
  • Transparent pricing from £2,950 per implant
  • 0% finance available over 12 months (subject to status)
  • Free initial consultation with no obligation
  • Saturday appointments available

Getting Here

By Tube

South Kensington Station (District, Circle & Piccadilly lines) is a 2-minute walk. Exit via the Old Brompton Road exit and turn right.

By Bus

Routes 14, 49, 70, 74, 345, 360, 414, C1 all stop nearby. Alight at South Kensington Station or Natural History Museum.

By Car

Metered parking available on Old Brompton Road (max 4 hours). NCP Queen's Gate car park is a 5-minute walk for longer appointments.
